[[Moca FC]] | continentalcup2 = [[CFU Club Shield]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = [[Atlético Pantoja]] | matches = 120 (including liguilla, semifinals, and finals) | total goals = | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | prevseason = [[Liga Dominicana de Futbol 2023|2023]] | nextseason = [[2025 liga dominicana de futbol|2025]] | updated = }} The 2024 season of the '''[[Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|Liga Dominicana de Futbol]]''' is the 10th season of [[Association football]] in the [[Dominican Republic]]. Before the season started, a one-game play-off match was contested between [[Atlántico FC|Atlantico FC]] and [[Atlético Pantoja|Atletico Pantoja]] at [[Estadio Leonel Plácido]]. The match was held to determine the last slots for the upcoming [[2024 CFU Club Shield]]. Atletico Pantoja won on penalties 4-2, securing them the 3rd and final slot for the Caribbean Cup.{{cite web |title=CLUB ATLÉTICO PANTOJA LOGRA BOLETO INTERNACIONAL |url=https://www.ligadominicanadefutbol.com/2024/03/03/club-atletico-pantoja-logra-boleto-internacional/ |website=Liga Dominicana de Futbol |access-date=4 March 2024}} The season started on 8 March 2024 with eight teams, as [[Don Bosco Jarabacoa FC|Jarabacoa FC]] has been relegated for the 2024 season in a decision to have their home turf renovated along with overall improvements to their club.{{cite web |title=LA LDF 2024 INICIARÁ 8 DE MARZO CON 8 CLUBES |url=https://www.ligadominicanadefutbol.com/2024/01/31/la-ldf-2024-iniciara-8-de-marzo-con-8-clubes/ |website=Liga Dominicana de Futbol |access-date=31 January 2024}} == Competition system == The [[Liga Dominicana de Futbol]] tournament will consist of three parts: * '' Regular Season: ''The competition format will have a regular three-round phase, with a minimum of twenty-one matches for all clubs.{{cite web |title=🗓️ AQUÍ ESTÁ EL CALENDARIO COMPLETO, Anota las fechas y nos vemos en los Estadios 🏟️ |url=https://twitter.com/LDFcomdo/status/1755354444345016686 |website=X |access-date=7 February 2024}} This phase will be played from March to July 2024. The six best qualifiers from the regular phase go to the Liguilla, in a round-robin format. From there, the best four teams advance to the semifinals, with their winners going to the grand final of the LDF 2024, all of which have 2-legged matches.{{cite news |title=La Liga Dominicana de Fútbol 2024 iniciará 8 de marzo con 8 clubes |url=https://elnuevodiario.com.do/la-liga-dominicana-de-futbol-2024-iniciara-8-de-marzo-con-8-clubes/ |access-date=11 February 2024 |publisher=El Diario Nuevo}} The order of classification of the teams will be determined in a general calculation table, as follows: * 1) Higher number of points; * 2) Greater goal difference in favor; in case of equality; * 3) Higher number of goals scored; in case of equality; * 4) Highest number of away goals scored; in case of equality; * 5) Fewest red cards received; in case of equality; * 6) Fewest yellow cards received; in case of equality; * 7) Draw. * ''Liguilla:'' The six teams classified from the regular season will play a system of all against all. Each team will play a total of five matches in their own field and in the opposite field, making a total of ten rounds. The top four teams at the end of the League will advance to the Play-offs. The ranking order will be the same as for the Regular Season. * '' Play-offs: '' An elimination system will be played, the first place in the Liguilla will face the fourth place and the second place will face the third. Both keys will be played in two games and the winners will advance to the Grand Final, which will also be played in two games. == Participating teams == A total of 8 teams will compete in the 2024 Tournament. === Teams by province === {| class="wikitable" |- !Province !N.º !Teams |- |[[Distrito Nacional]] | style="text-align:center" |2|| style="text-align:center" |[[Club Atlético Pantoja]] & [[Universidad O&M FC|O&M FC]] |- |[[La Vega Province|La Vega]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Atlético Vega Real]] |- |[[La Romana Province|La Romana]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Delfines del Este FC]] |- |[[Puerto Plata Province|Puerto Plata]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Atlántico FC]] |- |[[San Cristóbal, Dominican Republic|San Cristóbal]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Club Atlético San Cristóbal|Atlético San Cristóbal]] |- |[[Santiago Province, Dominican Republic|Santiago Province]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Cibao FC]] |- | [[Espaillat Province|Espaillat]] | style="text-align:center" |1|| style="text-align:center" |[[Moca FC]] |} ===Team information=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- style="color:#FFFFFF; text-align:center" !
